style: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: small website workflow-challenge icon. Primary request: ONE instantly recognizable icon:
finish: Style/medium: authentic hand-placed 16-bit retro game pixel art, chunky square pixels, crisp hard edges, simple readable silhouette, intentional stair steps. Color palette: deep navy outlines, sparse teal marks, warm cream highlights to match a parchment-toned educational website. Composition: centered single icon filling most of a square canvas, clear negative space, legible at 96 pixels. Transparent background. No words, letters, numbers, label, frame, card, mockup, gradient, glow, blur, smooth vector strokes, or watermark.
